topic: Class Template Constructor with Default Parameters and Allocator
explanation: In modern C++, standard library container classes like std::basic_string are implemented as class templates that can accept custom allocators for memory management. They provide multiple constructors, including those with default parameters, to facilitate flexible and efficient object creation. These constructors often utilize default template parameters and optional arguments, such as allocators, to allow users to specify custom memory allocators or rely on default ones. This design enhances the adaptability and performance of container classes in various contexts, especially in resource-constrained or performance-critical applications.
keywords: Custom allocator constructor, C++ template default arguments, STL allocator pattern, basic_string constructor
